label.description: The visible label, which also names the group. Without one, the group needs an aria-label or aria-labelledby, and an empty label does not count.

errorMessage.description: Shown once for the whole group, only while the group is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed native, custom, or server validation. It replaces the built-in message and never makes the group invalid by itself.

options.description: The radios the group builds, one per option. A non-empty options cannot be combined with children: passing both throws a TypeError.

children.description: RadioField radios, when the group does not build them from options. They cannot be combined with a non-empty options.

value.description: The value of the selected radio, when the caller controls it.

defaultValue.description: The value of the radio that starts selected, when the group controls itself.

disabled.description: Disables the group and every radio in it.

readOnly.description: Makes the group read-only: its radios stay visible and focusable but cannot be changed.

required.description: Marks the group required, so a form with native validation does not submit while no radio is selected.

invalid.description: Marks the group invalid and shows its error message. Left false, validation decides, so failed native, custom, or server validation can still make the group invalid.

orientation.description: Whether the radios stack in a column or sit in a row.

size.description: The control size. The radios take it from the group.

name.description: The form field name. A named group submits the selected value under it.

change.description: Called with the value of the radio each time one is selected. A disabled or read-only group does not call it.

members.name: id
members.description: The radio's key, which also stands in for the value when the option has none.

members.name: value
members.description: What the group's value, change callback, and form field carry when this option is selected.

members.name: label
members.description: What the radio shows beside its indicator. Without one it shows the value.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables this radio alone. A disabled group disables them all.

RadioOption.description: One radio the group builds from its options.
